nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

H3 removes the usual task boundaries between generation modes. Text-to-video, image-to-video, first/last-frame control, and reference-driven generation (character, motion, camera, voice, style) are all handled by one model instead of separate expert pipelines.

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector. H3's native canvas is a 768px short edge, capped at 768x1344 pixels, rounded to a multiple of 32
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node, snapping up to the model's 17-frame-per-block (17k+5) grid at 24fps

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

nodes.title: MiniMax H3 时间线导演台
Input Text (Prompt)
widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the young East Asian woman from <Picture 1>. Preserve her exact identity throughout the entire video: fair skin, oval face, natural facial proportions, shoulder-length dark brown hair, soft straight bangs, small silver hoop earrings, delicate pendant necklace, and dark navy Japanese sailor-style school uniform with white stripe trim. Her face, hairstyle, age, clothing, accessories, and body proportions must remain consistent in every frame.

<Video 1> is the complete 10.125-second reference video. It provides the exact action choreography, body movement, pose timing, camera movement, framing, scene transitions, rocky battlefield environment, blue-and-orange energy effects, lighting changes, debris motion, and final composition.

<Audio 1> is the synchronized original audio track from <Video 1>.

summary:
[video editing + reference generation + audio reuse]
Replace the original animated male character in <Video 1> completely with <Subject 1>. Preserve the original video’s action, timing, camera language, environment, visual effects, editing rhythm, and synchronized audio. Only the character’s identity, anatomy, hairstyle, face, and costume are replaced.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1>: fully_preserved — maintain the exact face, shoulder-length hairstyle, bangs, earrings, necklace, sailor uniform, colors, and realistic feminine anatomy from <Picture 1> without identity drift.

<Video 1>: partially_preserved — fully retain its motion choreography, poses, camera movement, framing, timing, battlefield, blue-and-orange energy, fire, lightning, smoke, flying rocks, lighting, and cuts. Remove only the original male character’s identity, spiky hairstyle, facial features, and orange martial-arts costume.

<Audio 1>: fully_copy — retain the complete original synchronized soundtrack without changing its timing, pitch, rhythm, sound effects, or music.

detailed_description:
Create a portrait-format cinematic fantasy action video following <Video 1> frame by frame.

[Shot 1, 00:00.000–00:05.000]
Place <Subject 1> in the original character’s exact foreground position and reproduce the same crouched combat posture, forward-reaching hand movement, determined gaze, head direction, and body motion. Preserve the original camera angle and forward camera energy. Blue supernatural energy develops on one side while orange fire and heat build on the other. Her shoulder-length hair and bangs respond naturally to the energy wind but never become spiky or change length. Her sailor uniform remains unchanged and moves naturally with her body. Keep her facial identity clearly recognizable even during fast motion and strong colored lighting.

[Shot 2, approximately 00:05.000–00:08.000]
Follow the original cut or transition into the wide battlefield composition. <Subject 1> performs the same rising and power-release action with the same timing. Massive blue and orange energy columns erupt around her; rocks, dust, sparks, smoke, and debris rise according to <Video 1>. Preserve the original camera movement and scale. Energy may illuminate her skin and clothing but must not recolor, redesign, obscure, or transform them.

[Shot 3, approximately 00:08.000–00:10.125]
Reproduce the final centered stance on the rocky ground. <Subject 1> stands firmly with the same posture and timing as the original character. Tall blue energy burns on one side and orange flame burns on the other while smoke and debris settle around her. Hold a powerful cinematic final composition until the video ends.

Use only one visible lead character. No duplicate person, no male character remnants, no face switching, no costume change, no extra limbs, no hand deformation, no anime-boy facial features, and no new dialogue or lip-sync.

overall_soundscape:
Fully reuse <Audio 1> from <Video 1>, maintaining exact synchronization with every energy burst, impact, debris movement, camera transition, and final power stance. Do not generate additional speech.

non_diegetic_music:
Fully copy the original music contained in <Audio 1>. Preserve its original timing, intensity progression, rhythm, and ending without replacement or remixing.
